<!-- Pipeline requires execution to generate ADES payload -->

<!--
  ADES: Astrometry Data Exchange Standard
  MPC/IAU - Version 2017

  Required Schema Tags (submit.xsd):
    <obsTime>  — ISO 8601 UTC
    <ra>       — Right Ascension (decimal degrees)
    <dec>      — Declination (decimal degrees)
    <astCat>   — Astrometric Catalog
    <rmsRA>    — Positional uncertainty σ_α (arcsec)
    <rmsDec>   — Positional uncertainty σ_δ (arcsec)
    <rmsCorr>  — Correlation coefficient ρ(α,δ)

  Privacy Protocol (PII):
    Personal names MUST NOT appear in <comment> tags.
    (MPC Privacy Policy 2019 · GDPR Art. 5(1)(c) Compliance)
-->
